selection_policy: Before commissioning new work, compare registered mission prompts with current evidence, unresolved decisions, tool readiness and bounded cost. Prefer a prompt expected to produce a new decision or reviewable delivery over one likely to repeat reviewed work. State why the selected prompt dominates the alternatives, or why none fits. Do not select a prompt merely because it is listed.

prompts.title: Improve encoder-based autocalibration
expected_deliverables: reviewable code change or a supported decision not to change code
measured prediction, applied-anchor and failure evidence
prompts.decision_value: Determines whether a proposed calibration change improves applied physical accuracy without degrading reliability or collection effort.
prompts.novelty: Broadest autocal implementation brief. Use when the question does not fit a narrower current prompt and the choice follows a fresh gap analysis.
prompts.readiness: General-purpose. Read the current agenda and recent admissions first so established profiling, stopping and ranking work is not repeated.

prompts.title: Generate and test broader autocal ideas
expected_deliverables: short ranked idea set grounded in prior art
bounded tests of the strongest novel ideas
reviewable implementation when one idea survives
prompts.decision_value: Opens new calibration directions when the existing candidate set is exhausted or a structural assumption needs challenge.
prompts.novelty: High only when it requires an explicit prior-art search and names ideas not already tested. Otherwise it can duplicate the research corpus.
prompts.readiness: Use for an explicitly exploratory assignment, not as a default when a narrower unresolved hypothesis already exists.

prompts.title: HP3 autocalibration across physical variation
expected_deliverables: per-anchor and maximum-error evidence across a bounded physical-variation matrix
reviewable code change or a scoped negative decision
prompts.decision_value: Tests whether a calibration improvement survives friction, perturbation and sensor-noise variation instead of fitting one nominal world.
prompts.novelty: Targets unresolved cross-machine failure and per-anchor accuracy. It explicitly supersedes general collection profiling unless new evidence identifies another bottleneck.
prompts.readiness: The six-primary fixed4mid matrix is complete. Development/evaluation accuracy gains transfer, but the preserved nominal workflow failure rejects force-default adoption. Keep5mid and do not repeat this exact matrix. A minimal explicit-encoder-budget transport candidate has fresh real-WebSocket before/after evidence and passed45JS/2noncollection headless checks; fixed review/integration remains manager-owned. Future physical work needs a different observable force policy, measured motors or corrected model. No full-autocal-with-fix confirmation was run.

prompts.title: Reduce autocal recording cost
expected_deliverables: bottleneck profile tied to concrete code paths
bounded candidate optimization with before/after measurements
prompts.decision_value: Determines whether recording or runtime overhead is the current practical constraint and whether a change preserves calibration quality.
prompts.novelty: Useful when new evidence names a recording bottleneck. General profiling is already mature, so a repeat without a new hypothesis has low value.
prompts.readiness: Conditional on a current bottleneck or cost claim. Verify it against the latest recording-performance evidence before commissioning.

prompts.title: Resolve the highest-cost researcher tooling gaps
expected_deliverables: verified list of tooling gaps that still exist in current code
one bounded implementation with regression evidence
explicit deferred items and their cost consequences
prompts.decision_value: Reduces lost runs or repeated manual work when the selected gap currently blocks reproducible research.
prompts.novelty: The wish list records historical failures, not proof that every gap remains. Select only an unmet item after inspecting current code and recent fixes.
prompts.readiness: Needs a verification pass before implementation. Prioritize durable jobs, supervisor parity and resumable checkpoints only if they are still missing.
